doc_friction.issue: Assigned quick-pick-survey though its previous PR (#15360) merged minutes earlier; the 24 h claim check reads only open PRs, so a just-merged venture looks free. Harmless here (the next item was buildable) but it means back-to-back runs on one venture.

Monitor watches expire after 5 min, so waiting on a ~50 min sweep took a dozen re-arms; a note that long sweeps are best launched as one run_in_background command (which notifies on exit) would save the churn.

goal: Measure whether anchor pairs make the lapse gate on the pooled prior's upper end worth shipping
notes: Measured, not shipped. scripts/gated-upper-sweep.ts gained --every (anchor pairs, the anchor sweep's rule), three anchor gates (anchor-half, anchor-tau, anchor-mass) and spreadRho; --every 0 reproduces the committed 2026-11-13 rows exactly (checked on the 8x2 share-0 shipped cell). 288 cells (every 5/10 x lapse 0.2/0.4 x seed bases 1000/50000 x 36, both selectors) in docs/anchor-gated-upper-2026-11-13.jsonl. Anchors lift AUC to 0.85-0.88 (1 in 5, lapse 0.4) but the whole-answer estimate rises equally; anchor rank gate 4-10% narrower than fixed vs oracle 10-18%; on all-honest panels the more consistent half pools to 1.71-1.94 vs 1.27-1.40 for everyone (selection on spread, rho -0.14 to -0.36). Gates closed; flagships next: (a) a pooled fit with per-person lapse in the likelihood. Checks: tsc --noEmit and eslint clean on the script; run_workflow_locally --for-changes (results in PR).
